ns2:course.label: Theological Librarianship
ns2:course.description: Provides an overview of the contexts, materials, services, and issues characterizing theological librarianship. Students interact with a number of librarians currently working in the field. 2 or 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 or 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
